title: Juicy Binchotan-Charcoal Kissed Wensleydale Korean Jjigae
description: A spicy, savory Korean-inspired stew featuring Wensleydale cheese and the rich flavor of binchotan-charcoal.
instructions: Prepare the dosirak (Korean rice bowl) by washing the rice thoroughly and cooking it according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and sauté the grated ginger and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the shiitake mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the Wensleydale cheese to the pan and stir until it starts to melt.
Add the binchotan charcoal powder, Korean chili flakes, fish sauce (if using), and soy sauce (if using) to the pan and stir to combine.
Use a spatula to press the mixture into the cataplana, ensuring an even layer.
Place the cataplana over low heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the mixture is heated through and the cheese is melted.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Serve the Korean Jjigae in the prepared dosirak immediately.
